data.long_meaning: Anjeet is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘anj’ which means ‘graceful, pleasing’. In Hindu mythology, Anjeet is the name of a divine being who bestows grace and blessings upon his devotees. The name Anjeet carries the meaning “Graceful, Pleasing” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Anjeet usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, pleasing and live with faith, good character and purpose.
